name: Soloogarmon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, for the turn 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and gets +3000 DP.
[All Turns] When Tamer cards are placed in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
source_effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [SoC] or [SEEKERS] trait doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
